fact: The mHealth Africa article says DHIS2 (the national database known as SIGSANTE) is the backbone of Côte d'Ivoire's National Health Information System and has centralised routine health data since its deployment in 2015.

The article says that since 2018 the national DHIS2 has integrated vaccination, epidemiological surveillance and community data flows, and that the mHealth community platform transmits data to it via HL7 FHIR APIs.
